cards.subject: A hole in the ground
lines: Desolace shipped in November with no dungeon under it. Maraudon arrived on the eighteenth of December, in a patch Blizzard titled "Mysteries of Maraudon".
For twenty-five days the Valley of Spears was a hole with centaur standing around it.

cards.subject: Two mouths, one dungeon
lines: The tunnel forks. The purple-crystal path has its own portal into the Wicked Grotto; the orange-crystal path has a separate one into Foulspore Cavern.
Two doors, two different halves of the same place.
They meet again at Poison Falls.

cards.subject: Cavindra
lines: A dryad standing at the pools. She is Celebras's sister, and she got out.
"This place... it's cursed. I barely managed to escape, and I cannot bear to go down through the tunnels again."
"My brother, and sisters though... They were not as fortunate."

cards.subject: Noxxion is a made thing
lines: He was built by the satyr on the other side of the dungeon, at the Princess's request. Razorlash was made to walk with him.
The fungal mass on the ceiling above him has its own animated model.
It dies when he does.

cards.subject: He got easier three months in
lines: Noxxion splits into five when he is hurt, and the patch explicitly made him easier "for groups lacking AoE damage."
An early sign Blizzard had noticed these dungeons were being run by whoever showed up.
Not by the right five.

cards.subject: Tinkerer Gizlock
cards.tag: He came in for the crystals
lines: Six goblin gem hunters walked in. The satyrs killed five of them.
Trapped and half-mad, the survivor declared himself king of the caves.
"Mine! Mine! Mine! Gizlock is the ruler of this domain! You shall never reveal my presence!"

cards.subject: Poison Falls
lines: "The meeting point of the physical corruption stemming from the Foulspore Cavern and the demonic taint stemming from the Wicked Grotto."
The result is a cascade of foul greenish water on the border of becoming slime.
Celebras stands at it, facing the clean side.

cards.subject: You kill him and he thanks you
lines: The Cursed dies and the Redeemed spawns in his place: "For so long I have drifted in my cursed form. You have freed me... Your hard work shall be repaid."
Then: "You wish to learn of the stone? Follow me."
And he walks you there himself.

cards.subject: The shortcut costs both halves
lines: It is assembled from a diamond off the purple side and a rod off the orange side.
You cannot build the shortcut without first walking the whole dungeon it shortcuts.
Then it drops the group straight into Earth Song Falls, forever.

cards.subject: Meshlok the Harvester
cards.tag: A rare spawn inside an instance
lines: Not a scheduled boss. A rare elite bog beast at the far end of the purple section, near where it meets the falls.
He is often simply not there.

cards.subject: Landslide was a gardener
lines: The way it is told, the ancient mountain giant cultivated brilliant crystal gardens down here for years.
Theradras enthralled him when she moved in.
Everything glittering around Earth Song Falls is his work, and he is fighting you against his will.

cards.subject: The clean half
lines: The first part of Maraudon free of taint — frogs, turtles and hydras instead of oozes and maggots.
At the top of it, the life still coming off Zaetar's body has turned the chamber into a verdant paradise of plants and still water.
He has been dead for millennia and the room is growing because of him.

cards.subject: Rotgrip
cards.tag: You have to fall to find him
lines: A crocolisk that has been in the water under this place for millennia.
He lives beneath Zaetar's Grave, and you reach him by jumping off the bridge to the island.
The last boss in the dungeon is optional, and most groups never see him.
